tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Check whether each inline citation in an answer is supported by the source it points to, using CrossSource's method and failure taxonomy (supported, right_doc_wrong_passage, wrong_document, unsupported_claim). Cites to ids not in `sources` and citations where another passage clearly covers the claim

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Check a claim or number about Zoeb Nomi against what zoebnomi.com states. Returns found, number_mismatch or not_found, with the site quote, source URL, evidence link, n and date where the site gives them. Use the returned quote, not your own paraphrase. A word lookup: it cannot see negation, so read

tools.name: fit_to_role
tools.description: Map a job description to Zoeb Nomi's public work (zoebnomi.com) with quoted evidence, and list requirements with no public evidence as gaps. Never answers compensation, availability, location or work authorization.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "fit_to_role" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
